title: International Study for Treatment of High Risk Childhood Relapsed ALL 2010 - A randomized Phase II Study Conducted by the Resistant Disease Committee of the International BFM Study Group – IntReALL HR 2010
official: International Study for Treatment of High Risk Childhood Relapsed ALL 2010 - A randomized Phase II Study Conducted by the Resistant Disease Committee of the International BFM Study Group – IntReALL HR 2010
summary: Main objective: Improvement of CR2 rates after induction with ALL R3 with bortezomib versus without bortezomib in HR relapsed ALL patients

interventions.name: Oncaspar 750 U/ml powder for solution for injection/infusion
VELCADE 3.5 mg powder for solution for injection
Dexamethasone phosphate Accord 4 mg/ml injeksjons-/infusjonsvæske, oppløsning
Vincristine Sulfate 1 mg/ml Solution for Injection or Infusion
Mitoxantrone 2 mg/ml concentrate for solution for infusion

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Morphologically confirmed diagnosis of 1st relapsed precursor B-cell or T-cell ALL
2. Children less than 18 years of age at date of inclusion into the study.
3. Meeting HR criteria (any T BM relapse, early/very early isolated BM relapse, very early isolated/combined extramedullary relapse)
4. Patient enrolled in a participating centre
5. Written informed consent
6. Start of treatment falling into the study period
7. No participation in other clinical trials 30 day prior to study enrolment that interfere with this protocol, except trials for primary ALL
Exclusion criteria:
1. BCR-ABL/ t(9;22) positive ALL
2. No consent is given for saving and propagation of pseudonymized medical data for study reasons
3. Severe concomitant disease that does not allow treatment according to the protocol at the investigator’s discretion (e.g. malformation syndromes, cardiac malformations, metabolic disorders
4. Subjects unwilling or unable to comply with the study procedures
5. Subjects who are legally detained in an official institute
6. Pregnancy or positive pregnancy test (urine sample positive for β-HCG > 10 U/l)
7. Sexually active adolescents not willing to use highly effective contraceptive method (pearl index <1) until 12 months after end of anti-leukemic therapy
8. Breast feeding
9. Relapse post allogeneic stem-cell transplantation
10. Neuropathy > II°
11. The whole protocol or essential parts are declined either by patient himself/herself or the respective legal guardian
12. Objection to the study participation by a minor patient, able to object
13. Any patient being dependent on the investigator
